VMTP.ActorBackup.Title: Actor Backup
VMTP.ActorBackup.Hint: Backup Seed items that rebuild a targeted actor from a snapshot
VMTP.ActorBackup.NoTargets: Target the token(s) on the canvas, then refresh.
VMTP.ActorBackup.BackupNote: One Backup Seed per targeted actor, loose on the Items sidebar. Spells and runtime state are not captured.
VMTP.ActorBackup.Seeds: Backup Seeds on the Items sidebar
VMTP.ActorBackup.RestoreNote: Restore rebuilds the single targeted token's actor from a seed. The seed on the sidebar is kept; a copy used from an actor's inventory is consumed.
VMTP.ActorBackup.RestoreNeedOne: Target exactly one token to restore onto.
VMTP.ActorBackup.BadSeed: No valid snapshot on this seed.
VMTP.ActorBackup.TypeMismatch: Seed is a {seed} snapshot; the targeted actor is a {actor}.
VMTP.ActorBackup.RestoreAsk: This will WIPE everything on {actor} and rebuild them as {name} from this seed ({items} items, made {created}). Current HP, conditions, and spells are not part of a seed.
VMTP.ActorBackup.Busy: A backup or restore is already running.
VMTP.ActorBackup.DescUse: Use this from an actor's inventory to restore that actor (wipes them first, consumes the seed).
VMTP.ActorStamp.Title: Actor Stamp
VMTP.ActorStamp.Hint: Stamp feats, traits, gear, and gold onto actors from saved stamps
VMTP.ActorStamp.NpcHint: NPC is prefixed automatically. NPC stamps only ever stamp NPCs.
VMTP.ActorStamp.PickFirst: Pick a stamp from the list first
VMTP.ActorStamp.LaneNpc: NPC stamp: stamps NPCs only, via canvas selection.
VMTP.ActorStamp.NoTargets: No eligible targets. Select tokens or pick a PC.
VMTP.ActorStamp.Skipped: Never stamped (levels and race are per character): {list}
VMTP.ActorStamp.BannerSub: {name}: a document, not an actor. Levels and races will not stamp. Gold delivers weightless.
VMTP.ActorStamp.BannerTip: This is a document, not an actor. Class levels and races will not stamp. Carried gold on this sheet delivers to targets as weightless currency.
VMTP.Looter.Title: Compendium Looter
VMTP.Looter.Hint: Search every compendium, then view, import, copy, or hand a hit to an actor
VMTP.Looter.Placeholder: Search compendiums, two characters or more
VMTP.Looter.Start: Type at least two characters to search.
VMTP.Looter.None: No matches for "{needle}". Try another term.
VMTP.Looter.ImportTip: Import a copy into the world
VMTP.Looter.AddTip: Add to selected tokens, else your assigned character
VMTP.Looter.NotAddable: Only Item documents can be added to an actor
VMTP.Looter.CopyTip: Copy the UUID to the clipboard
VMTP.Looter.NoSheet: That document has no sheet to open.
VMTP.Looter.NoTarget: Select a token or assign a character first.
VMTP.Looter.AddFail: Add to Actor failed, see the console.
VMTP.HostileReset.Title: Hostile Inventory Reset
VMTP.HostileReset.Hint: Wipe loot and coin from hostile NPCs on the scene, chosen by name group
VMTP.HostileReset.Start: Press Scan to list hostile NPC groups on this scene. Nothing is written until you confirm.
VMTP.HostileReset.Footer: Purging: physical items plus all currency
VMTP.HostileReset.NoHostiles: No hostile NPCs found on this scene.
VMTP.HostileReset.AskWarn: About {items} item(s) plus all currency will be wiped. This cannot be undone.
VMTP.HostileReset.Done: Purged {items} item(s) and reset currency on {tokens} token(s).
VMTP.IdentifyAll.Title: Identify All
VMTP.IdentifyAll.Hint: Mark every unidentified item on the selected tokens as identified
VMTP.IdentifyAll.NoSelection: Select one or more tokens on the canvas, then refresh.
VMTP.IdentifyAll.Ask: Identify every unidentified item on {n} selected actor(s)?
VMTP.Inspect.Title: Inspect Inventory
VMTP.Inspect.Hint: Item by type breakdown of the selected token, updates as selection changes
VMTP.Inspect.NoSelection: Select a token on the canvas.
VMTP.LootSearch.Title: Loot Search
VMTP.LootSearch.Hint: Search every inventory on the scene, pick up one item, put it down on another token
VMTP.LootSearch.NeedPiles: Player mode needs the Item Piles module.
VMTP.LootSearch.NoTokens: No tokens with actors on this scene.
VMTP.LootSearch.NoPiles: No reachable item piles on this scene.
VMTP.LootSearch.CopyTip: Copy into the Hand, the source keeps its item
VMTP.LootSearch.PickUpTip: Pick up into the Hand, removed from the source
VMTP.LootSearch.TokenGone: That token is no longer on the scene. Rescan.
VMTP.LootSearch.ItemGone: That item is no longer there. Rescan.
VMTP.LootSearch.HandFull: Hand is full. Put down or drop the held item first.
VMTP.LootSearch.PickUpFail: Pick up failed, see the console.
VMTP.LootSearch.PutDownTip: Put down on the selected token
VMTP.LootSearch.PutDownFail: Put down failed, see the console.
VMTP.Purge.Title: Purge Inventory
VMTP.Purge.Hint: Delete every physical item on the selected token, features untouched
VMTP.Purge.NoSelection: Select a token on the canvas, then refresh.
VMTP.Purge.None: {name} has no physical items to purge.
VMTP.Purge.Ask: Permanently delete {n} physical item(s) from {name}? Feats, spells, classes, races and buffs are kept. This cannot be undone.
VMTP.SkillStamp.Title: Skill Stamp
VMTP.SkillStamp.Hint: Define custom skills and stamp them onto actors as proper sheet skills
VMTP.SkillStamp.Name: Skill name
VMTP.SkillStamp.ListHint: Committing an existing key updates that skill. A deleted skill is removed from actors on the next stamp.
VMTP.SkillStamp.DeleteAsk: Remove "{key}" from the list? Actors lose it on the next stamp.
VMTP.SkillStamp.NeedKey: Short key is required (lowercase letters and numbers).
VMTP.SkillStamp.CoreKey: "{key}" is a core skill key, pick another.
VMTP.SkillStamp.NoCore: Core skill list unavailable. Is the pf1 system active?
VMTP.SkillStamp.ScopeAll: Every character and NPC in the world
VMTP.SkillStamp.StampHint: Adds missing skills, updates changed definitions (ranks and notes preserved), and removes managed skills no longer listed. Core skills are never touched.
VMTP.Transfer.Title: Transfer Inventory
VMTP.Transfer.Hint: Move every physical item and all coins from the first selected token to the second
VMTP.Transfer.NeedTwo: Select two tokens: source first, destination second.
VMTP.Transfer.Same: Both tokens share one actor. Nothing to move.
VMTP.Transfer.Ask: Move every physical item and all coins from {src} to {dst}? Features stay put. This cannot be undone.
VMTP.Transfer.Done: Moved {items} item(s) and {coins} coin(s) from {src} to {dst}.
